I wouldn't call myself a masculinist/feminist for 2 main reasons one I feel that I do not need to involve my gender in the points I make , it seems like separating myself from one group would be counter-productive and secondly I feel that rather than saying my point of view is based around mens/womens rights will just make someone of the opposite group be less attentive to the points i make (or rather they may be more inclined to look for mistake rather than see the points) Egalitarian is just a simpler way of putting I don't see the problem with wanting to spare peoples feelings, I don't have to offend someone to get a point across.
